CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLOANPAYOFF_LNS
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff
AS(
SELECT
BLG.FORACID
,BLL.BANK_ID
,BLL.PAYOFF_DATE
,BLL.PAYOFF_REASON_CODE
,BLL.PAYOFF_FLG
,BLLD.RECORD_STATUS
,BLL.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BUSC.LNS_LAACCTMAST_DELTA BLLD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_LAACCTMAST BLL ON BLL.ACID = BLLD.ACID AND BLL.BANK_ID = BLLD.BANK_ID AND BLL.ISLATEST = '1'
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST BLG ON BLG.ACID = BLLD.ACID AND BLG.ISLATEST = '1' 
WHERE BLG.FORACID IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff_SRC
AS
(
SELECT 
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
FORACID
,BANK_ID
,PAYOFF_DATE
,PAYOFF_REASON_CODE
,PAYOFF_FLG
)) HASHROW, FORACID, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,PayoffTimestamp
,PayoffReasonCode
,PayoffIndicator
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanPayoff
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FORACID, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,CASE
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff_SRC SRC
    FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.FORACID = TGT.CustomerAccountId
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
CustomerAccountId = SRC.FORACID
,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.BANK_ID
,PayoffTimestamp = SRC.PAYOFF_DATE
,PayoffReasonCode = SRC.PAYOFF_REASON_CODE
,PayoffIndicator = SRC.PAYOFF_FLG
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS'
,WORKFLOWID = 0
,TASKRUNID = 0
,INSERTDTTM = SRC.INSERT_DTTM
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanPayoff TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff SRC ON SRC.FORACID = TGT.CustomerAccountId;


INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanPayoff
(
 CustomerAccountId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,PayoffTimestamp
,PayoffReasonCode
,PayoffIndicator
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM   
)

SELECT
FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
,BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,PAYOFF_DATE AS PayoffTimestamp
,PAYOFF_REASON_CODE AS PayoffReasonCode
,PAYOFF_FLG AS PayoffIndicator
,'LNS' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM  AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountLoanPayoff_DELTA;

END
